'''Skeressa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Skeedo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] hired individuals to hijack arms shipments to the local [[Militia/Legends|militia]] of Skeressa.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Taking Down a Rival}}</ref>
